name: Lost in the Void
source:
The space-ship was on its way elsewhere. It lost its course and crashed. Almost every crew-member died. These, who survived, try hard to find a way out of the mess. The problem is - there are creatures who want to control humans. And they won't let them out.

Made for Community Game Jam #1

[Edited from [url=https://hisaribi.itch.io/lostinthevoid]Itch.io[/url]]
